cda_2008_part_i.comparison: The official DESW search index independently identifies Part I as 30 June 2008, 733 KB. The indexed PDF cover and preface agree with the local CDA copy on title and effective date. DESW byte equivalence is unverified. A distinct corrected Part I locator has indexed printed pages beyond the CDA file pagination and must retain its own version identity.
cda_2008_part_i.policy_summary: CDA policy permits download without prior permission and conditions reproduction on accuracy, nonmisleading presentation, and prominent attribution. It excludes identified third-party copyrights and refers other uses to CDA approval. Application of the policy to this Ministry of Defence PDF and any derivative repository publication is unresolved.
cda_2008_part_i.desw_policy_summary: The indexed DESW website policy requires permission by email for reproduction of its featured material. No permissions were requested or inferred.

army_pension_part_ii.official_index_evidence: CGDA indexed cover identifies Ministry of Defence Pension Regulations for the Army Part II (2008), incorporating orders through 30 June 2008. DESW indexes Part II as 849 KB.
army_pension_part_ii.disposition: Hold automated document acquisition. The CGDA policy recheck received an HTTP 503 at the www origin and a proxy CONNECT 403 at the bare origin, which previously returned 503. Both DESW policy hosts returned HTTP 403. No current original bytes or derivative verified.
